caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bench with a high back and armrests, positioned horizontally across the center of the image. The bench is brown in color, with a rich wood grain visible throughout its surfaces. The seat consists of three wide wooden planks. The backrest features a row of evenly spaced, vertically-oriented turned spindles, supported at the bottom by a solid wooden plank and framed by thicker wooden posts at each end. The armrests are slightly curved and supported by additional vertical, turned spindles that match those in the backrest. The bench is supported by four turned legs connected by horizontal stretchers, which include several decorative, thicker segments with symmetrical, geometric shapes. The background is a plain light beige or tan color, free of additional objects or details. The composition is centered, with the bench viewed from the front, showing all details of its structure and craftsmanship.
title: Settee
